title: Cascade Arrest Mechanisms: Which Interventions Stop a Harmful Cascade Once Started?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: implement cascade -> apply arrest mechanisms at different steps -> measure harm reduction and disruption. Produces actionable guidance on last-resort interventions. Each link is explicit.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires implementing a harmful cascade in a 4-agent network and five different arrest mechanisms, each applied at four different timing points. Substantial engineering for a multi-agent system far beyond beginner level.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 5 mechanisms x 4 timing points = 20 experimental conditions on a 4-agent network. Very broad scope. Even testing one mechanism at one timing point requires the full cascade infrastructure.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
